meaning.en: Having a gaze as bright as a torch; also, having sharp insight.
meaning.zh: 目光像火炬一样明亮，形容见识卓越或愤怒的样子。

examples.zh: 老教授目光如炬，一眼就看出了问题。
examples.en: The old professor was keen-eyed and spotted the problem at once.

examples.zh: 他目光如炬地盯着对方。
examples.en: He fixed the other man with a blazing stare.

examples.zh: 投资高手往往目光如炬。
examples.en: Top investors usually have a piercing eye for opportunity.

usage.en: Predicate; can mean sharp insight or a fierce glare.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可指见识高远，也可指目光凌厉。

meaning.en: Bound tightly with ropes round the neck, arms and body.
meaning.zh: 用绳子把人的脖子、胳膊和身体紧紧捆起来。

examples.zh: 劫匪被警察五花大绑地押上了车。
examples.en: The robbers were trussed up and put into the police van.

examples.zh: 他被五花大绑，动弹不得。
examples.en: He was tied up tight and couldn't move.

examples.zh: 电影里的人质都被五花大绑。
examples.en: The hostages in the film are all tied up.

usage.zh: 多作状语或用于被动句。

meaning.en: Needles and thread; trifling household odds and ends.
meaning.zh: 指缝纫用的针线，也泛指零碎的小东西。

examples.zh: 她的小篮子里装满了针头线脑。
examples.en: Her little basket was full of needles, thread and bits and bobs.

examples.zh: 街角的杂货铺卖些针头线脑。
examples.en: The corner shop sells haberdashery and small goods.

examples.zh: 这些针头线脑的小事，别放在心上。
examples.en: Don't dwell on these trifling matters.

meaning.en: Alternating effort with rest; a balanced pace.
meaning.zh: 一会儿紧张，一会儿放松，指做事松紧结合、有节奏。

examples.zh: 学习要一张一弛，不能一直绷着。
examples.en: Study should alternate effort and rest; don't stay tense all the time.

examples.zh: 文武之道，一张一弛。
examples.en: The way of governance is to alternate tension and ease.

examples.zh: 工作一张一弛，效率才高。
examples.en: Work with a balance of pushing and resting and you'll be more efficient.

story.en: Confucius is quoted: 'To only tighten and never slacken, even kings Wen and Wu could not manage it; to only slacken and never tighten, they would not do it; one tightening and one slackening is the way of Wen and Wu' (一张一弛，文武之道也).
story.zh: 《礼记》：“张而不弛，文武弗能也；弛而不张，文武弗为也；一张一弛，文武之道也。”

meaning.en: The height of goodness and beauty; perfect.
meaning.zh: 好到极点，美到极点。

examples.zh: 世上没有至善至美的事物。
examples.en: Nothing in the world is utterly perfect.

examples.zh: 他追求至善至美的艺术境界。
examples.en: He pursues the highest artistic perfection.

examples.zh: 这幅画的构图可谓至善至美。
examples.en: The painting's composition is as perfect as it gets.

meaning.en: Soft on the surface but hard or sharp underneath.
meaning.zh: 比喻外表柔和，内心刚强或暗藏心机。

equivalents: an iron fist in a velvet glove

examples.zh: 她说话绵里藏针，让人不敢小看。
examples.en: Her words are soft but sharp underneath; no one dares underestimate her.

examples.zh: 这封回信客气得绵里藏针。
examples.en: The reply was polite on the surface, with barbs within.

examples.zh: 别看他笑眯眯的，其实是个绵里藏针的人。
examples.en: For all his smiles, he's a needle in cotton.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; can be mildly pejorative.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，略含贬义。

natural: with connections in the highest places

meaning.en: Having extraordinary influence and connections, even at the top.
meaning.zh: 形容神通广大，有极大的手段和门路，多指有权势的人。

examples.zh: 他自称手眼通天，什么事都能办成。
examples.en: He claims he has friends in high places and can fix anything.

examples.zh: 别以为你手眼通天，法律面前人人平等。
examples.en: Don't think you're so well connected; everyone is equal before the law.

examples.zh: 传说那个商人手眼通天。
examples.en: Rumour has it the businessman has connections everywhere.

meaning.en: Gloomy clouds and mist; a heavy, miserable atmosphere.
meaning.zh: 惨淡的云雾，形容令人愁苦的气氛或景象。

examples.zh: 消息传来，全家笼罩在愁云惨雾之中。
examples.en: When the news came, a pall of gloom fell over the family.

examples.zh: 公司裁员，办公室里愁云惨雾。
examples.en: With the layoffs, the office is shrouded in gloom.

examples.zh: 战后的城市愁云惨雾。
examples.en: The post-war city was steeped in misery.

meaning.en: Barely continuing, like a thread about to snap; also, of sound, faint but unbroken.
meaning.zh: 像细线一样连着不断，形容局势危急、勉强维持，或声音细微悠长。

examples.zh: 战局危急，王朝的命运不绝如缕。
examples.en: The war was desperate, and the dynasty hung by a thread.

examples.zh: 远处的笛声不绝如缕。
examples.en: The faint notes of a flute drifted on.

examples.zh: 他的一线生机不绝如缕。
examples.en: His slender hope of survival barely held on.

usage.en: Literary; note 缕 is pronounced lǚ.

meaning.en: Flustered and unable to think straight.
meaning.zh: 心里慌张，思绪混乱。

examples.zh: 考试前他心慌意乱，什么也看不进去。
examples.en: Before the exam he was in a flap and couldn't take anything in.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她心慌意乱。
examples.en: Hearing the news, she was thrown into a panic.

examples.zh: 别心慌意乱，先冷静下来。
examples.en: Don't panic; calm down first.

meaning.en: Weighed down by profound suffering.
meaning.zh: 遭受的苦难非常沉重。

examples.zh: 那个苦难深重的民族终于迎来了新生。
examples.en: That deeply afflicted nation finally saw a new dawn.

examples.zh: 战争让这片土地苦难深重。
examples.en: War has brought deep suffering to this land.

examples.zh: 她的一生苦难深重。
examples.en: Her whole life was one of deep hardship.

meaning.en: War breaks out on all sides.
meaning.zh: 到处燃起报警的烽烟，指战乱四起。

examples.zh: 边关狼烟四起，朝廷震动。
examples.en: With beacon fires on the frontier, the court was alarmed.

examples.zh: 乱世之中狼烟四起，百姓流离失所。
examples.en: In the troubled age, wars broke out everywhere and the people were displaced.

examples.zh: 这部小说开篇就是狼烟四起的场景。
examples.en: The novel opens with a scene of war flaring on all sides.

meaning.en: Both serious and humorous at once.
meaning.zh: 既严肃又诙谐，指言谈或文章庄重中带着幽默。

examples.zh: 他的演讲亦庄亦谐，听众笑声不断。
examples.en: His speech was both earnest and funny, drawing constant laughter.

examples.zh: 这篇散文风格亦庄亦谐。
examples.en: This essay mixes gravity and humour.

examples.zh: 主持人亦庄亦谐，很受欢迎。
examples.en: The presenter is both serious and witty and very popular.

natural: learn from the past to foresee the future

meaning.en: To study the past in order to understand the future.
meaning.zh: 借鉴过去的经验，了解和预见未来。

examples.zh: 读史可以鉴往知来。
examples.en: Reading history lets us learn from the past and foresee the future.

examples.zh: 我们要鉴往知来，避免重蹈覆辙。
examples.en: We must learn from the past and not repeat its mistakes.

examples.zh: 鉴往知来，才能走好今后的路。
examples.en: Only by looking back can we walk the road ahead well.

natural: as spring and autumn come and go

meaning.en: Seasons passing; time flying by.
meaning.zh: 春天过去，秋天到来，指岁月流逝。

equivalents: as the seasons come and go

examples.zh: 春去秋来，转眼十年过去了。
examples.en: Seasons came and went, and ten years flew by.

examples.zh: 春去秋来，老人依旧守着小店。
examples.en: Year after year, the old man still kept his little shop.

examples.zh: 春去秋来，孩子们都长大了。
examples.en: As the seasons turned, the children grew up.

meaning.en: To be astonished at ordinary things because one has seen little.
meaning.zh: 见识少，遇到平常的事物也觉得奇怪。

examples.zh: 这种东西城里到处都是，你别少见多怪。
examples.en: They're everywhere in the city; don't be so easily amazed.

examples.zh: 你这是少见多怪，大家早就习惯了。
examples.en: You're just easily impressed; everyone's long been used to it.

examples.zh: 出了几趟远门，他才知道自己过去是少见多怪。
examples.en: After a few trips away, he realised how provincial he had been.

pinyin: wǔ shí bù xiào bǎi bù
literal: fifty · paces · laugh at · hundred · paces
natural: the pot calling the kettle black

meaning.en: One who retreated fifty paces mocking one who retreated a hundred; a minor fault mocking a major one.
meaning.zh: 败退五十步的人讥笑败退一百步的人，比喻自己与别人缺点错误相同只是程度较轻，却去讥笑别人。

equivalents: the pot calling the kettle black
a small sinner mocking a bigger one

examples.zh: 你迟到十分钟还笑他迟到半小时，这不是五十步笑百步吗？
examples.en: You're ten minutes late and laughing at him for half an hour; isn't that the pot calling the kettle black?

examples.zh: 两家公司都有问题，互相指责不过是五十步笑百步。
examples.en: Both firms have problems; blaming each other is the pot calling the kettle black.

examples.zh: 他嘲笑别人偷懒，自己也不过是五十步笑百步。
examples.en: He mocks others for slacking, but he's no better.

story.en: Mencius to King Hui of Liang: soldiers who fled fifty paces laughed at those who fled a hundred; 'though they did not go as far, they were fleeing all the same' (以五十步笑百步，则何如？).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“兵刃既接，弃甲曳兵而走，或百步而后止，或五十步而后止。以五十步笑百步，则何如？”

pinyin: bù gǎn yuè léi chí yī bù
literal: not · dare · cross · Lei · Pool · one · step
natural: not dare to step out of line

meaning.en: Not daring to go beyond the set limits.
meaning.zh: 不敢超越规定的范围，不敢有所逾越。

equivalents: not dare step out of line

examples.zh: 他做事谨小慎微，不敢越雷池一步。
examples.en: He's so cautious he never dares step out of line.

examples.zh: 在规章面前，员工们不敢越雷池一步。
examples.en: Employees dare not go beyond the rules.

examples.zh: 她被家教管得不敢越雷池一步。
examples.en: Her strict upbringing meant she never dared overstep.

story.en: Wen Qiao wrote to Yu Liang: 'I fear you will not cross Lei Pool by even one step' (无过雷池一步), warning him to stay put.
story.zh: 温峤致书庾亮：“足下无过雷池一步也。”

usage.en: Often 不敢越雷池一步 or 不越雷池一步.

meaning.en: A person without real ability who poses as an expert.
meaning.zh: 指没有真才实学而混在行家里充数的人。

examples.zh: 那个所谓的专家不过是南郭先生。
examples.en: That so-called expert is just an impostor.

examples.zh: 团队里不能养南郭先生。
examples.en: A team can't afford to carry a passenger like a Mr Nanguo.

examples.zh: 他在乐队里滥竽充数，活像个南郭先生。
examples.en: He fakes it in the band like the Mr Nanguo of the story.

story.en: Mr Nanguo, who could not play the yu, joined King Xuan of Qi's three-hundred-strong ensemble and hid among them; he fled when the next king demanded solos.
story.zh: 《韩非子》：“齐宣王使人吹竽，必三百人。南郭处士请为王吹竽，宣王说之，廪食以数百人。”

meaning.en: To pretend to understand what one doesn't.
meaning.zh: 自己不懂却装作懂。

examples.zh: 不懂就问，千万别不懂装懂。
examples.en: If you don't know, ask; never pretend to.

examples.zh: 他不懂装懂，结果闹了笑话。
examples.en: He pretended to know and made a fool of himself.

examples.zh: 面试时不懂装懂，很容易露馅。
examples.en: Bluffing in an interview is easily seen through.

usage.en: Predicate; Confucius: 知之为知之，不知为不知.
usage.zh: 可参看“知之为知之，不知为不知”。

meaning.en: Drums and music resounding to the sky.
meaning.zh: 鼓声和乐声响彻天空，形容场面热闹。

examples.zh: 婚礼上鼓乐喧天，热闹非凡。
examples.en: At the wedding, drums and music rang out in great festivity.

examples.zh: 迎亲的队伍鼓乐喧天。
examples.en: The bridal procession came with drums and music blaring.

examples.zh: 开幕式现场鼓乐喧天。
examples.en: The opening ceremony was alive with music.

usage.zh: 多作谓语；可比较“锣鼓喧天”。
